kirish: Quyidagi matnlar Tayanch uchun yaratilgan o‘quv namunalari. Ular haqiqiy talabaning hayoti yoki qabul natijasini tasvirlamaydi. Qavsli joylar tekshiriladigan shaxsiy dalil bilan to‘ldiriladi. Har namunadan keyin tuzilishini ko‘ring va o‘z tajribangiz bilan yangi matn yozing.

en: The first version of our project looked convincing on my screen. It produced an answer, displayed a chart, and gave me something I could explain quickly. When a teammate asked what would happen if the input were incomplete, I opened a different file instead of answering.

I had spent more time preparing the demonstration than understanding the failure. That afternoon, I began a separate notebook for cases that made the system behave badly. Some entries were mundane. Others showed assumptions I had never written down. The notebook gradually became more useful than the slides.

At our next meeting, I brought an example that failed. Explaining it felt uncomfortable. I could no longer present myself as the person who had solved the problem. But the conversation changed. A teammate questioned how we had prepared the data. Another suggested a simpler comparison. We began making decisions together instead of dividing the work into pieces that only one person understood.

I now keep a place for uncertainty in a project before I choose how to present it. I document what I tried, what I could observe, and what still needs an explanation. This habit also changed how I ask for help. A clear account of a failed attempt gives another person something to work with.
I still enjoy seeing a system run. The more lasting satisfaction comes when I can explain why I trust a result, where that trust ends, and which question should come next.
uz: Loyihamizning birinchi versiyasi ekranimda ishonchli ko‘rinardi. U javob chiqardi, grafik ko‘rsatdi va menga tez tushuntirish mumkin bo‘lgan natija berdi. Jamoadoshim kirish ma’lumoti to‘liq bo‘lmasa nima bo‘lishini so‘raganda, javob berish o‘rniga boshqa faylni ochdim.

Men nosozlikni tushunishdan ko‘ra namoyishni tayyorlashga ko‘proq vaqt sarflagandim. O‘sha kuni tizim noto‘g‘ri ishlaydigan holatlar uchun alohida daftar boshladim. Ayrim yozuvlar oddiy edi. Boshqalari esa ilgari yozib qo‘ymagan taxminlarimni ko‘rsatdi. Asta-sekin daftar slaydlardan foydaliroq bo‘lib qoldi.

Keyingi uchrashuvga ishlamagan misol olib bordim. Uni tushuntirish noqulay edi. Endi o‘zimni muammoni hal qilgan odam sifatida ko‘rsata olmasdim. Ammo suhbat o‘zgardi. Bir jamoadoshimiz ma’lumotni qanday tayyorlaganimizni savol ostiga qo‘ydi. Boshqasi sodda taqqoslashni taklif qildi. Har kim faqat o‘z bo‘lagini tushunadigan ish o‘rniga qarorlarni birga qabul qila boshladik.

Endi loyihani qanday ko‘rsatishni tanlashdan avval undagi noaniqlik uchun joy ajrataman. Nimani sinaganimni, nimani kuzatganimni va yana nima izoh talab qilishini yozaman. Bu odat yordam so‘rashimni ham o‘zgartirdi. Muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishning aniq tavsifi boshqa odamga ham ishlash uchun asos beradi.
Tizim ishlaganini ko‘rish hanuz yoqadi. Natijaga nega ishonishimni, bu ishonchning chegarasini va keyingi savolni tushuntira olganimdagi qoniqish esa uzoqroq qoladi.
namunalar.tahlil: Sahnada kichik qaror bor, o‘rtada shaxsiy harakat va hamkorlik, oxirida esa keyingi ishga ta’sir ko‘rinadi. Profilingizga tegishli bo‘lmagan voqeani o‘zingizniki sifatida ishlatmang.

en: Working on [verified project] made me interested in how [specific constraint] changes the reliability of [method]. I can implement the current pipeline, but I need stronger preparation in [relevant mathematical or experimental area] to evaluate its assumptions. The [verified course] and [verified research group] in [programme] would let me connect that preparation to a focused project. I would bring experience in [personal contribution], including the limitations documented in [evidence]. My first aim would be to reproduce an appropriate baseline and discuss a feasible research question with the group.
uz: [Tekshirilgan loyiha] ustida ishlash [aniq cheklov]ning [usul] ishonchliligiga qanday ta’sir qilishiga qiziqtirdi. Hozirgi jarayonni amalga oshira olaman, ammo uning taxminlarini baholash uchun [tegishli matematik yoki tajriba sohasi] bo‘yicha chuqurroq tayyorgarlik kerak. [Dastur]dagi [tekshirilgan fan] va [tekshirilgan research guruh] shu tayyorgarlikni aniq loyiha bilan bog‘lashga yordam beradi. Men [shaxsiy hissa] tajribasi hamda [dalil]da qayd etilgan cheklovlarni olib kelaman. Birinchi maqsadim tegishli bazaviy natijani qayta ishlab ko‘rish va guruh bilan bajariladigan research savolini aniqlash bo‘ladi.

en: I want to investigate how [specific problem] can be evaluated under [realistic constraint]. My interest developed through [verified project], where I was responsible for [personal contribution]. The project taught me that choosing a method and establishing when it can be trusted are separate research tasks.

My preparation includes [relevant courses] and practical work using [methods actually used]. In [project], I implemented [specific component], compared it with [documented baseline], and examined [observed failure mode]. The result supported [limited, verified conclusion]. It also left [open question], which I could not address with the available [data, time or resources].

I am applying to [exact degree] because [verified curriculum feature] would strengthen my preparation in [needed area]. The work of [verified group or faculty member] on [specific topic] is relevant to the question I want to develop. I would first need to establish access to [required data or equipment] and refine the project with an appropriate supervisor.

During the master’s, I aim to become better at designing comparisons, communicating uncertainty and producing work that others can examine. After the degree, I intend to pursue [feasible next step], building on the training rather than assuming a research outcome in advance.
uz: Men [aniq muammo]ni [haqiqiy cheklov] sharoitida qanday baholash mumkinligini o‘rganmoqchiman. Qiziqishim [tekshirilgan loyiha] davomida shakllandi, unda [shaxsiy hissa] uchun javobgar edim. Loyiha metod tanlash va unga qachon ishonish mumkinligini aniqlash alohida research vazifalari ekanini ko‘rsatdi.

Tayyorgarligim [tegishli fanlar] va [amalda ishlatilgan metodlar] bilan amaliy ishni o‘z ichiga oladi. [Loyiha]da [aniq komponent]ni amalga oshirdim, [hujjatlangan baseline] bilan solishtirdim va [kuzatilgan xato]ni tahlil qildim. Natija [cheklangan va tasdiqlangan xulosa]ni qo‘llab-quvvatladi. Shu bilan birga [ochiq savol] qoldi, uni mavjud [ma’lumot, vaqt yoki resurs] bilan hal qila olmadim.

Men [aniq daraja]ga topshiryapman, chunki [tekshirilgan o‘quv imkoniyati] [kerakli soha]dagi tayyorgarligimni kuchaytiradi. [Tekshirilgan guruh yoki olim]ning [aniq mavzu]dagi ishi rivojlantirmoqchi bo‘lgan savolim bilan bog‘liq. Avval [zarur ma’lumot yoki uskuna]ga kirish yo‘lini aniqlab, tegishli rahbar bilan loyiha ko‘lamini belgilashim kerak.

Magistratura davomida taqqoslashni loyihalash, noaniqlikni tushuntirish va boshqalar tekshira oladigan ish yaratishni yaxshilamoqchiman. Keyin [amalga oshadigan keyingi qadam]ni rejalashtiryapman, research natijasini oldindan va’da qilish o‘rniga olingan tayyorgarlikka tayanaman.

juftlar.en: Documented the project’s data assumptions and added a reproducible evaluation script.
juftlar.uz: Loyiha ma’lumotlari haqidagi taxminlarni hujjatlashtirdim va qayta ishlatish mumkin bo‘lgan tekshiruv skriptini qo‘shdim.

juftlar.en: Organised peer review of project notebooks and maintained the team’s issue log.
juftlar.uz: Loyiha daftarlarining o‘zaro tekshiruvini tashkil qildim va jamoaning muammolar ro‘yxatini yuritdim.

juftlar.en: Prepared worked examples for a peer study group and revised them using learner feedback.
juftlar.uz: Tengdoshlar o‘quv guruhi uchun ishlangan misollar tayyorladim va o‘quvchilar fikri asosida yangiladim.

namunalar.qoralama: Universitetingiz dunyodagi eng yaxshi. Men texnologiya orqali butun dunyoni o‘zgartiraman.
namunalar.qoralama_en: Your university is the best in the world. I will change the entire world through technology.
namunalar.topshiriq: Dasturdagi tasdiqlangan imkoniyat, o‘zingizning aniq tajribangiz va bajarilishi mumkin bo‘lgan keyingi qadam bilan qayta yozing.
namunalar.tekshiruv: O‘quvchi siz nimaga tayyor ekaningizni, nimani o‘rganmoqchi ekaningizni va nima uchun shu dastur kerakligini tushuna oladi.
